specs.Item Highlight: Folding Stand for Hands-Free Reading, Hand Strap for Secure Carrying, Embossed Leather Exterior, Protective E-Reader Cover

features: CUSTOM FIT E-READER COVER: This sleek, fashion-forward case is meticulously designed for Kindle Paperwhite 12th Generation (2024 model). Crafted with high-quality black PU leather, it offers a modern look while delivering dependable everyday protection. Perfectly contoured for the 7-inch e-reader display, it ensures a precise and comfortable fit.

FOLDING DESK SUPPORT: The built-in folding stand feature transforms your Kindle into a hands-free reading station. Simply fold back the cover to create a stable stand, allowing you to read comfortably on a table, desk, or bedside without needing to hold the device for extended periods.

HANDHELD GRIP BAND: Designed for convenience, the secure elastic hand strap on the inside of the cover provides a firm and comfortable grip. It reduces the risk of accidental drops and allows one-handed reading on the go, offering a stable hold whether you're commuting, relaxing, or reading outdoors.

MAGNETIC CLOSURE & AUTO SLEEP FUNCTION: The integrated magnetic closure keeps your Kindle safely shut when not in use, providing added protection against dust and scratches. The smart auto sleep/wake function conserves battery life by seamlessly turning your screen off when closed .

ANTI-SCRATCH & DURABLE PROTECTION: The sturdy construction and soft inner lining safeguard your Kindle from everyday wear, scratches, and minor bumps. Its anti-scratch finish preserves the sleek look of your device, ensuring it remains in pristine condition no matter where you take your e-reader.
